entry.title: OxZygen 0.7.7 (beta)
entry.summary: # OxZygen v0.7.7 ## What's new - **Instruments browser card:** OxZygen now shows as its own card in Sounds > INSTRUMENTS. entry.title: OxZygen 0.7.6
entry.summary: # OxZygen v0.7.6 ## What's new - **Seven new recorded instruments**, in two new sound categories on the SOUND page: - **Keys:** grand piano, electric piano, concert harp. - **Mallets:** glockenspiel, hand chimes, kalimba, marimba. - They work like the bells: Decay, Shimmer and Tone knobs, and they layer with any other sound. The download grows from 131 MB to 169 MB. - **Tempo sync:** two pickers on the FX page. - **Delay SYNC:** FREE (the Time knob, as before) or a note value: 1/16, 1/8T, 1/8, 1

entry.title: OxZygen 0.7.5
entry.summary: # OxZygen v0.7.5 ## What's new - **Mono output option:** in Logic (and other hosts) the plugin can also go on a mono instrument track; the sound is the stereo sound folded to one channel. - **Browse page:** a new BROWSE tab with the categories on the left (All, Voices, Winds, Brass, Strings, Bells, Synth, Air) and that category's presets on the right. entry.title: OxZygen 0.7.4
entry.summary: **What's new in 0.7.4:** the FX page's Q-Links follow its panels again.
